svg.aria-label: Traces stream from your agent in production into flow-1, which reads every one of them; the count of traces read goes up with each. Most traces have no issue. Failing ones turn orange and land in Issues: Wrong refund amount grows from 3 to 5, Report contradicts tests from 1 to 2, and a new issue, Stuck retrying login, is discovered. The top issue then goes round the improvement loop: its traces are turned into eval cases, the fix is shipped to the agent, and the issue is marked fixed.
